findings.summary: Mass-spring-damper step response stays at x=0 (expected 0.1 m): vlab.test.ts, M-01, whitebox master mechanical.
pid_ac_motor lab: repeated ImplicitSolver convergence failures and timeout (5 s) in labs_sim.test.ts.
M-02 rotational spin-up: signal J remains zero for the whole run.
Thermal whitebox T-01 fails the judge and T-02 initial T = 0.057 K instead of about 293 K (initial condition handling).
Fluid whitebox F-01 gas flow resistance fails the oracle judge.
gas_flow_sensor and gas_pressure_sensor have no symbol (fall back to UnknownSymbolGlyph)
test:vlab:all-blocks hangs forever on gas_pipe (infinite loop, over 90 s in isolation).
test:vlab:all-blocks hangs again after gas_reservoir output with gas_pipe excluded. Block unconfirmed.
tsc: 2 TS2339 errors in src/services/sysmlCommandGateway.ts lines 1483 and 1602 (not V-Lab).

Unwired optional physical inputs read 0, not undefined, so the param fallback never fires. Fixed only for force/torque/ang_vel/gas_pressure sources. Remaining: vlabEquations ~L142,180,291,755,1393,1402,1650,2160 (R_ctrl, gas_restriction area, Q_in...). Fix centrally in the assembler.

thermal_ref is pinned at 293.15 K (DAEAssembler ~L1034). Simscape thermal reference = 0 K, so temp_sensor reads T-293.15. WP-04 made the whitebox T-01/T-02 probes read the absolute node instead; WP-15 must fix the reference and RESTORE the sensor probes.

test_all_blocks_scope passes by design even when the solver errors (16 blocks). The fixtures are ill-posed for force/torque_source, motion sensors, belt_spool, luenberger_observer. Also failing: opamp, three_phase_source, gas_reservoir, gas_rotational_conv, gas_translational_conv, reluctance_force, ma_pressure_source, dist_constraint, microwave_inverter, mass_flow_source. Make fixtures well-posed and turn errors into failures.
ImplicitSolver fails to converge on the induction motor + inverter, so steps keep halving. pid_ac_motor and vlab_comprehensive L3-001..003 can time out.
Not in baseline and failing at HEAD: test_pressure_sensor gas mass flow, vlab_comprehensive L6-004, vlab_readiness_gate GATE-01, vlab_validation_contracts (2).
Dead params: shown in the UI but never read by the equation. The user edits them with no effect. Triage per domain WP (inventory-gaps.md).
Equation reads params the library does not expose (some are aliases). Triage per domain WP.
Ports without a domain field (132 blocks have no port domain at all). Fix in WP-03.
Library ports never read by the equation. This is a candidate list: many are signal outputs written through DAE branches. Verify in WP-03 and the domain WPs.
Orphan equation keys (aliases or legacy). Confirm whether old models need them, else remove.
No per-block help: HELP_DATA has 25 topic entries. 23 blocks have no component definition.

No usable MATLAB/Simscape on this machine. Golden CSVs cannot be generated. build_rc_charging.m has never been executed (library paths and param names are unverified). The simscape column stays pending until goldens arrive.
